title: Lock the board composition
question: Night Console is locked. Which composition should the Ronin tracking page build to? The chosen image becomes the spatial contract.

options.label: Tiled console
options.thesis: Four persistent panels: list, map, facts, history. Selection changes contents, never layout.
options.viewport: Equal-presence tiles. Best when comparing several shipments while reading one.
options.risk: The map can feel boxed-in if the list is long.

options.label: Map owns the night
options.thesis: The map is the workspace. Facts float as a legend. History is a console footer.
options.viewport: Slim left rail of numbers; geography is the product.
options.risk: Facts are smaller; a data-heavy shipment may feel cramped in the overlay.

options.label: Selected theater
options.thesis: Tracking numbers are a buffer strip. The selected shipment owns map, facts, and history.
options.viewport: One shipment at a time, deeply. Switching numbers is a buffer click.
options.risk: Comparing two shipments side by side is harder.
